ORIENT.rule: Load the exact current A+B pair first; provider fabric only supplies operational bindings and may not override A+B.

DOMAIN_RETRIEVE.rule: Executor derives privacy-approved candidates, probes only registered provider adapters, rebuilds the bounded plan from fresh route observations, reads only CURRENTLY_OBSERVED_REACHABLE/RESULT routes, and validates each returned item against exact route/source/privacy/evidence-capability boundaries.

PROJECTION_RECONCILE.rule: For one registered projection, apply ref/path scope and privacy gates before provider I/O, probe and read the exact registered source/target routes, distinguish unavailable routes from absent target objects, then run the registered projection audit/reconciler.

PROJECTION_AUDIT.rule: Supply fresh provider observations; source activity outside registered ref/path scope is NOT_APPLICABLE, not stale.

RECONCILE.rule: Compare exact revision/generation/digest evidence; observation timestamps never break exact-object conflicts.

ADMIT_PROPOSITION.rule: After typing/currentness reconciliation, select the matching resolver_dispatch row for the exact domain/proposition/referent tuple before terminal resolver acceptance. Readable or VERIFIED_EXACT provider evidence remains insufficient when the selected dispatch requires a different decisive evidence class; missing or ambiguous dispatch fails closed.

CHECKPOINT.rule: Persist only minimum-necessary pointers/digests/status needed to resume; never copy specialist payloads merely for convenience.

adapter_boundary.probe_contract: Adapter reports transport observation for the exact requested route only; reachability does not establish currentness, authority, or evidence type.
adapter_boundary.read_contract: Adapter returns one ProviderEvidenceEnvelope for the exact requested route/source or explicitly absent when the exact object is not present. Executor revalidates provider identity, route/source binding, privacy class, and target capability ceiling; absence is not silently converted into unavailability or success.
adapter_boundary.credential_rule: Credentials/configuration remain runtime/provider concerns and are never embedded in this source hook or provider fabric.

background_execution.rule: Source code and this hook do not execute between turns by themselves. Active-runtime execution occurs only when a runtime invokes the hook. Offscreen continuous monitoring requires a separately evidenced scheduler/runtime invocation.

effect_boundaries.source: Repository source establishes the hook design and executable support only; it does not establish native installation, activation, provider effect, runtime consumption, or behavioral qualification.
effect_boundaries.installation: Native installation requires exact native readback binding this exact hook/A+B/provider-fabric tuple.
effect_boundaries.runtime_consumption: Runtime consumption requires observable execution evidence for the exact runtime/operation and cannot be inferred from source presence.
effect_boundaries.provider_effect: Provider mutation requires separate operation-specific authority plus exact readback; this hook alone authorizes no provider write.
effect_boundaries.qualification: Behavioral qualification requires separately executed exact-tuple qualification including fresh live-provider replay; source tests and live provider reads do not self-qualify Vera.

promotion_guards: Provider persistence is not present truth or current Vera self-state.
Temporal chronology is not semantic/currentness authority.
Retrieved item type must be independently established.
VERIFIED_EXACT reconciliation is not proposition authority; resolver dispatch remains a separate gate.
Operational checkpoint state never silently becomes autobiographical/current-self-state memory.
Patrick authority and Vera self-authored stance remain actor/referent/proposition specific.
Adapter availability and scheduler output are operational evidence only and never policy authority.
